annotations.annotation_text: Anna Livia Plurabelle (ALP), the archetypal feminine principle, mother, and personification of the River Liffey flowing through Dublin to the sea, manifested as "Alp".

annotations.annotation_text: Viconian philosophical framework: Giambattista Vico's cyclical schema of history (divine theocratic age, heroic aristocratic age, human democratic age, and ricorso), invoked through "thunder".
sources: Vico, Giambattista. Scienza Nuova (The New Science, 1725). https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/
Beckett, Samuel, et al. Our Exagmination Round His Factification... https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Giambattista Vico. https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/
